Question 5

Consider the finite region bounded by the curves x=5y−2y2 and x=y, as shown above. Find an integral expression for the volume generated when this region is rotated 2π radians about the x-axis.

a
2π∫02y(4y−2y2)dy
b
π∫02y(2y2−4y)2dy
c
2π∫02(4y−2y2)2dy
d
2π∫02y(6y−2y2)dy
e
2π∫02y(2y2−4y)dy
